frequency_question: What proportion of strike threats by major federation-level labor coalitions result in actual indefinite strikes within the designated window?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide federation strike notices or ballots resulting in formal strike dates set within 60 days of notice; excludes localized single-employer disputes or unorganized walkouts.
coverage_note: 5 named comparable federation-level instances; believed roughly 8-10 in total globally within comparable heavily regulated banking/public utility sectors
known_gaps: Excludes smaller regional unions and non-federated single-bank unions.
skeleton: 5 major national federation strike cycles evaluated across comparable regulated labor environments
multiplier: 2 hits out of 5 documented comparable cycles
validity_reason: Labor dispute dynamics and government intervention patterns evolve slowly over multi-year regulatory regimes.
